judgementCalls: The CV's Personal Information block gives a date and place of birth, sex and marital status; none of the forbidden terms may appear in the profile.
A place of birth is not an explicit statement of citizenship, so work authorisation stays null.
The CV is headed and summarised as a housekeeper, so a chef or cook first target role is not accepted despite the earlier chef jobs.
'Many years of hard work' is not a stated figure, so no years are keyed.
